'''''Wind Racer''''' is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' darter.

[[Cemeille din Selaan Long Eyes]], [[Sailmistress]] of ''Wind Racer'', learns of the suicide of the [[Amayar]] and sails as fast as she can to [[Illian]] to tell the [[Mistress of the Ships]] the news.{{ref/book|11|22}}
